liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer calls this the best Morning Dew ever; Reviewer says this version rivals many of the best 1977 versions [5][12][14][15]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry smokes in this Sugaree [18]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Garcia's playing as exceptional [19]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer says Garcia's playing is exceptional here [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **DJ Banter/Encore Break**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-04-27.167535.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): FM broadcast; 19 songs; 181 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98429.flac24**: FM broadcast; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Disc transitions are seamless, with light broadcast static on disc 1 track 3 [3]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98430.flac16**: FM broadcast; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 3.8/5 by 10 [4]
- **gd77-04-27.sbd.samaritano.20331.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 171 min; rated 4.21/5 by 38 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience mikes were boosted between songs so heavily that the reviewer finds it aversive; Reviewer's old tape was terrible; this CD source sounds noticeably better; Sound is mediocre, and the between-song audience mike is found annoying [12][14][15][18]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: DJ [1]
- Between songs the audience mikes were turned up, and WNEW's Richard Near narrated, apparently knowing little about the Dead [9]
- A black-and-white video of the show circulates; the reviewer finds Jerry unusually excited on guitar [16]
- Reviewer rates this show far above 4/23, which got many more rave reviews [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-04-27.167535.fm.glassberg.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Matt Smith;Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master FM Reel (Pioneer TX9500 tuner > TEAC A3300S Reel @ 7 1/2 ips, Maxell UD180B) > 1st Generation Reel @ 3 3/4 ips [1]. Also: Recorded by Barry Glassberg; first-generation reel source and transfer by Matt Smith; pitch correction helped by Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98429.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: FM reel master [3]. Also: FM source from a widely circulated show; uploader doubts a pre-FM could have come from WNEW [3]
- **gd1977-04-27.fm.moore.berger.98430.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: wnew simulcast>10.5" reel @ 7.5 ips, dolby b technics rs-1506>sony nr-335>hd-p2 24/48>cd wave> adobe 2.0 16/44>flac [4]. Also: FM source upgrading the uploader's prior copy; uploader doubts a pre-FM from WNEW exists [4]
- **gd77-04-27.sbd.samaritano.20331.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Reviewer taped the show off FM; that copy was lost and later copies were many generations down; Pre-FM master reel soundboard to DAT; DAT seed from Dan Lynch, patch and SHN transfer by Joe Samaritano [5][13]
